item.title: North Korea hasn’t resumed regular flights to Shanghai, counter to schedule
item.description: North Korea’s flag carrier Air Koryo has not resumed regular flights from Pyongyang to Shanghai, despite listing a biweekly schedule for the route running until March, aviation data shows. Air Koryo used three different aircraft to conduct a total of four flights to Shanghai in April, May, June and November, following the airline’s first flight […]

item.title: North Korea invites China firms to spring trade fair after foreign ban last year
item.description: North Korea has invited Chinese companies to attend an upcoming spring trade fair in Pyongyang, according to a Chinese trade association, a signal that foreign participants from select countries will be able to join the event after their exclusion last year. item.title: North Korean hackers using QR codes to attack governments and think tanks: FBI
item.description: The FBI has warned that a North Korean cybercrime group known for its prolific espionage operations is using QR codes to launch spear-phishing attacks against U.S. and foreign government entities and other institutions. The Pyongyang-backed actor Kimsuky targeted nongovernmental organizations, think tanks, academia and foreign policy experts by embedding malicious QR codes in phishing emails […]
